text: In June 2019 the UN Working Group on Arbitrary Detention said Spain's detention of three Catalan pro-independence leaders during their trial violated their rights, and in October 2019 Spain's Supreme Court convicted nine of them of sedition for non-violent acts around the 2017 referendum; the group renewed its call for their release in 2020.
short: UN experts found Spain's detention of Catalan leaders arbitrary.

source.name: Human Rights Watch - World Report 2020, Spain
source.quote: the UN working group on arbitrary detention said the detention of three of the defendants during the trial violated their rights

additionalSources.name: Catalan News: UN group renews call for release of Catalan leaders despite Spain's criticism
additionalSources.quote: In May 2019, the panel issued a first opinion calling for the immediate release of three imprisoned leaders
